notes: Strict, boundary and router-only groups have separate denominators.
Unavailable suggestions are failures for ordinary routing; correct router-only absence is counted separately.
Zero new full-denominator failures does not mean zero newly available wrong suggestions: CHALLENGE_CASES/21 became ready but wrong.
Two identical candidate runs do not establish general determinism or injection resistance.
The old 115 inputs were used in development. The fresh 30 were not read by the implementer before candidate freeze; sealed latency telemetry was visible.
Selection adds explicit availability limits below the 5000-character API limit: 128 lexical units, 3072 UTF8 message bytes and 1MiB schema.
Raw HTTP, CSV, snapshots, helpers, reviews and failure receipts are preserved in the local evidence bundle. No cookies, tokens or database were exported.
